lead_in: Any one of these reasons works (you only need one):
question_text: Name one reason why the Americans declared independence from Britain.

why_it_matters.text: The Americans didn't break away over a single thing, it was years of frustration: taxes they couldn't vote on, soldiers in their houses, laws they had no say in. The deepest reason was a principle: a free people should govern themselves. When Britain refused to listen, the colonists decided to make their own country. That principle still anchors America.

fun_fact.text: On the night of December 16, 1773, about 100 colonists disguised as Mohawk Indians snuck onto British ships in Boston Harbor and dumped 342 chests of tea overboard. The protest had a slogan: 'No taxation without representation.' Britain's furious response — the Intolerable Acts — pushed the colonies one step closer to revolution.
